agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: “And not just any strength.” “Strength like a wild ox.” “Then Balaam turns to the subject of spells and divination.”

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The final sentence tells Balaam's move into the subject of spells and divination, which comes from Numbers 23:23, but the card cites only Numbers 23:22.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards points toward a lioness and a lion rather than the other animal pictures. The baker can only guess the unseen wording of the oracle's closing image.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.

agent.problem: The coverage of Numbers 23:24 stops at naming the lioness and the lion. The cards never tell that the people do not rest until they devour their prey and drink the blood of the slain, leaving out the close of Balaam's second oracle.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
